profile.name: Casey Thornton
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.bio: I have spent the last fifteen years building software for teams that care deeply about craft and quality. I have worked across the stack — from embedded firmware to distributed cloud systems — and I am most at home in the space where product intuition meets technical rigour. I write about engineering culture, team health, and the slow art of building things that last. When I am not at a keyboard, I am usually somewhere outside with bad maps and good company.
